Liao Cao Studio

Good Wishing Chinese Characters Sculpted Porcelain Cup

HG-LC-GWCSC1

Regular price $ 85.00
/
Shipping calculated at checkout.

Sip good fortune with every pour.
Each cup features an auspicious Chinese character sculpted into the vessel itself — not painted, but shaped into the very walls of the porcelain. Light moves across its subtle relief like ink across parchment, revealing brush-strokes you can feel with your fingertips.

Rooted in the wisdom of the Thousand Character Classic, these cups transform calligraphy into form — a blessing you can hold.

Crafted through a hybrid process, each cup begins with 3D-printed precision then moves into the hands of master artisans for refinement. Our bespoke jade-porcelain clay is blended with natural pigment and fired at 1,320 °C for a touch of translucence, like jade warmed by sunlight.

Perfect for tea or coffee — elegant enough for display, intimate enough for daily ritual.

Good Wishing Characters

Choose a cup that carries the blessing you want to give or receive:

Character Meaning Best For
福 · Fu – Fortune / Luck The most universal blessing — like a lantern at the door inviting good things to arrive. New beginnings, housewarmings, everyday luck.
禄 · Lu – Prosperity / Wealth The flowing path of success, status, and thriving career. Promotions, entrepreneurial wins, business gifts.
寿 · Shou – Longevity / Health Gentle as spring rain and long as pine roots — a wish for life filled with strength and years. Elders, birthdays, recovery gifts.
囍 · Xi – Joy / Double Happiness A happiness so abundant it must be written twice. Weddings, engagements, new unions.
發 · Fa – Fortune Multiplied (Get Rich) Opportunity rising like bamboo after rain — fast, bold, expansive. Business ventures, financial milestones.
福禄 · Fu Lu – Fortune & Prosperity Luck and success arriving hand-in-hand — the classic pairing of abundance. Career advancement, first homes, prosperous life goals.
福寿 · Fu Shou – Fortune & Longevity May blessings last as long as life itself — wealth of years and wealth of spirit. Birthday celebrations, parents, grandparents.
喜喜 · Shuang Xi – Double Happiness The echoing joy of two hearts aligned. Auspicious and festive. Marriage, anniversaries, family blessings.
福禄寿囍 · Fu Lu Shou Xi – Auspicious Four The complete constellation of blessings — wealth, longevity, fortune, and shared joy. Grand gifts, family legacy, milestone moments.

 

Gift Box Options:

Single Cup Gift Box - Default packaging for individual cup.

Duo Cup Gift Box - Select any two characters and we’ll present them side by side in one elegant box — perfect for couples or complementary characters.

Four Cup Gift Box - Present a complete cycle of well-wishing. Choose four characters or select the Auspicious Four (福禄寿囍) to symbolize a full, prosperous and joyful life — ideal for weddings, family gifts, major milestones, and homes built with intention.

Dimensions

Teacups measure approximately 65 mm (2.56 in) in diameter by 50 mm (1.96 in) high with a capacity of around 65 mL (2.2 fl oz).

Care

To preserve the integrity of the porcelain, hand washing is recommended; avoid abrupt temperature changes, and use gentle cleansers instead of abrasive pads. 

Order & Delivery (IMPORTANT!)

All character cups are custom made by specialized craftsmen in China, typically taking 5–7 days to produce. Delivery may take an additional 9 to 14 days depending on your exact location. For time‑sensitive gifting, we recommend leaving 2 to 3‑week lead time.

Return & Refund

Custom orders like this are non‑returnable or refundable. However, if the product arrives damaged, please take pictures and contact us as soon as possible, and we will help you with a replacement or refund.

Need help choosing a character or gift‑box configuration?

We’re here to guide you in selecting a meaningful character for any occasion. Reach out with your questions (use "Ask A Question" function below or email info@chopsueyclub.com), and we’ll help create a memorable piece that honors birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, or any special milestone.

      Liao Cao Studio

      Custom Chinese Name Characters Sculpted Porcelain Cup

      Regular price $ 85.00
      /
      Shipping calculated at checkout.

      Turn your name into a personalized tea cup! Chinese characters are sculpted into the form of the cup itself, creating subtle undulations that catch light and reveal the strokes from every angle. 

      Each character cup embodies the union of ancient script and contemporary craftsmanship. Drawing inspiration from the classical Thousand Character Classic, the design transforms two‑dimensional calligraphy into a tactile three‑dimensional experience. 

      This concept is supported by a hybrid process: 3D printing establishes the precise topography of each character, while skilled artisans finish and refine the piece by hand. The cups are fashioned from a proprietary “jade porcelain clay” in which pigments are blended into the body, then fired at around 1 ,320 °C to achieve a lustrous, translucent finish.

      The pieces are suitable for tea or coffee, and the delicate relief makes them as pleasurable to hold as they are to behold.

      Gift Box Options:

      Single Cup Gift Box - Default packaging for individual cup.

      Duo Cup Gift Box - Select any two characters and we’ll present them side by side in one elegant box — perfect for couples or complementary characters.

                                      Liao Cao Studio

                                      Custom Chinese Name Characters Sculpted Porcelain Cup

                                      Regular price $ 85.00
                                      /
                                      Shipping calculated at checkout.

                                      Turn your name into a personalized tea cup! Chinese characters are sculpted into the form of the cup itself, creating subtle undulations that catch light and reveal the strokes from every angle. 

                                      Each character cup embodies the union of ancient script and contemporary craftsmanship. Drawing inspiration from the classical Thousand Character Classic, the design transforms two‑dimensional calligraphy into a tactile three‑dimensional experience. 

                                      This concept is supported by a hybrid process: 3D printing establishes the precise topography of each character, while skilled artisans finish and refine the piece by hand. The cups are fashioned from a proprietary “jade porcelain clay” in which pigments are blended into the body, then fired at around 1 ,320 °C to achieve a lustrous, translucent finish.

                                      The pieces are suitable for tea or coffee, and the delicate relief makes them as pleasurable to hold as they are to behold.

                                      Gift Box Options:

                                      Single Cup Gift Box - Default packaging for individual cup.

                                      Duo Cup Gift Box - Select any two characters and we’ll present them side by side in one elegant box — perfect for couples or complementary characters.
